function: The color-scheme property indicates which operating system color scheme an element should render with.

values.function: The element can be rendered with the OS default color scheme
The element can be rendered with the OS light color scheme
The element can be rendered with the OS dark color scheme
The element should only be rendered with the OS light color scheme. Forbids the browser to override the color scheme for the element
The element should only be rendered with the OS dark color scheme. Forbids the browser to override the color scheme for the element
